朝が近い。
閉じた目蓋、眠りについたままの意識で、夜の終わりを感じていた。

pages.en:
Morning is close.

My eyes are shut, my mind still asleep, but I can feel the night ending.

残っているのは、心地のいい気怠さだけ。
手は剣を握れないほど疲れきっていて、体には一絞りの魔力も残っていない。
正直に言ってしまえば、衛宮士郎は燃え尽きていた。

pages.en:
All that remains is a pleasant weariness.

My hands are too exhausted to hold a sword. There isn’t a drop of magical energy left in my body.

To put it plainly, Shirou Emiya has burned himself out.

、あ」
だが、それは悔いの残る終わりじゃない。
とりあえず今の自分で出来る事
やるべき事をキチンと終わらせた達成感がある。
燃え尽きているのは今だけの話だ。
休息をとった体は少しずつ脈打ち始め、じき、新しい朝を迎えようとウズウズしている。

“—Ah.”

But it isn’t an ending I regret.

For now, I’ve done what I could—finished what I had to do. There’s satisfaction in that.

I’m only burned out for the moment.

Rested, my body begins to pulse with life again, little by little. Soon it will be restless for a new morning.

My thoughts grow clearer.

The gray inside my head rocks on the edge of sleep. Any moment now, I’ll wake.

Just before I do, I remember him one last time.

振り返らず何も語らず。
自身を恥じなかった背中だけを俺に残して。

The billowing coat is gone.

Taking with him the sky I had thought would burn forever, that man has left.

Without looking back. Without a word.

Leaving me only the sight of a back that bore no shame.

同じ理想、同じ道を歩んだ男の姿に手を伸ばす。
勝った以上は、決して逃げない。
いつか必ずおまえに追い付くと、空のまま、強く手を握り締め

My eyes follow the path he took.

One possible ending.

I reach toward the man who pursued the same ideal, walked the same road.

Now that I’ve won, I will never run away.

One day, I swear, I’ll catch up to you. My empty hand closes tight—

I wake in the morning sunlight.

Sitting up, I find my body oddly heavy and covered in wounds here and there.

“…Huh. This is my room.”

Still foggy, I look around, then check the clock.

Just after ten in the morning. February sixteenth.

“Whoa. A whole day’s gone by.”

I make a start at being surprised, but my head stays perfectly calm, as though it has happened to someone else.

I’ve slept a whole day, and only now woken up.

No. She can’t even be here.

人の手にあまるサーヴァントを繋ぎ止められるモノは、この世から消え失せている。
故に
あの金の髪をした少女は、もう、この世の何処にもいないのだ。

The Holy Grail no longer exists.

The thing that could bind Servants, beings beyond human power, has vanished from this world.

And so—the girl with golden hair is nowhere in this world anymore.

部屋は、静まり返っていた。
冬の朝は冷たく、吸い込む空気は肺を締め付ける。
……長いようで短かった時間。
この二週間に起きた出来事と、この部屋に残った彼女の面影が通り過ぎていく。

“Ah… That’s right.”

Covering my eyes with one hand, I tip my face toward the ceiling as though trying to hold something back.

The room is utterly still.

The winter morning is cold. Each breath tightens my lungs.

…A time that seemed so long, and was so short.

The events of these two weeks pass through me, along with the traces of her left in this room.

伝えたい事は、その後で”

もう触れあう事はなく、
三人で戻ってこれる事はないと気付いていて、
叶わないと知りながら、俺たちは別れを口にしなかった。

She said that and ran off. It was the last I saw of her.

…Her back as she ran away.

There would be no afterward.

We would never touch again.

The three of us would never come home together.

We knew it. We knew that wish would never come true, and still we didn’t say goodbye.

Every joint aches when I move, reminding me that the battle wasn’t a dream.

While the bread toasts, I crack the eggs into the pan.

I set out plates to the sizzling of the oil and make two perfect fried eggs.

I draw a long breath.

The girl who waited for breakfast here every morning is gone.

Only now does it feel real.

…The fighting is over.

The struggle for the Holy Grail has ended.

How stupid of me, to realize it only now—only when morning comes without her.

It’s a fine day outside.

For some reason, I want to see the dojo where she and I first really talked. I leave the extra breakfast behind.

pages.en:
Still holding Saber’s hand, Tohsaka calls to me.

She’s stopped in the garden outside the dojo and is waving.

“…I give up. She really doesn’t wait for anyone.”

She’s dragged me this way and that often enough already. That won’t change.

As long as I’m with her, this will be an everyday occurrence.

You need some serious resolve to keep up with Tohsaka.

But, as she would say, what choice do I have?

It’s because she is who she is that we made it this far. And she is the person I fell in love with.

“Come on, hurry up! If you don’t get moving, we’ll start without you!”

Even as she says it, she stays right where she is, waiting for me.

For all her bad temper and coldness, she’s an incorrigible soft touch at heart.

“Yeah, coming! Just wait a second!”

I leave the dojo and follow them.

Tohsaka is here. Saber is here.

Tohsaka would never sit quietly in one place. And Saber, for all appearances, has a fierce competitive streak. She’ll go anywhere too.

With the three of us together, life is bound to be so restless that even Dad would throw up his hands.
